title: Client
description: Represents a business client or customer organization that engages with a company for services or products. Contains contact information, business details, and relationship status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the client record

name.description: Official company or organization name of the client

contact_person.description: Full name of the primary contact person representing the client

email.description: Primary business email address for client communications

phone.description: Primary business phone number including country and area codes

address.description: Street address and building number of the client's primary business location

city.description: City where the client's primary business is located

country.description: Country where the client's business operates

industry.description: Primary industry sector or business category the client operates in (e.g., Technology, Healthcare, Finance)

status.description: Current relationship status with the client (e.g., active, inactive, prospect, terminated)

contract_value.description: Total monetary value of contracts or agreements with this client

since.description: Date when the business relationship with this client was established
